<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Record page 3 column layout">426a984e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c582</macroponent><name>On Embedded Queries Fetched</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.name === "DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED") {
        var output = api.data.km_record_page_fetch_embedded_queries_1.output;
        if (output.success) {
            var content = output.content;
            if (content) {
                var query = api.context.props.query;
                for (var fieldName in content) {
                    var queryKey = '^' + fieldName + '=';
                    if (query && query.indexOf(queryKey) > -1)
                        continue;
                    api.emit("KB_VIEW#SET_FIELD", {
                        fieldName: fieldName,
                        value: content[fieldName]
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>felipe.valenca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>ee6ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c553</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On Embedded Queries Fetched</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Escola Virtual" source="x_fub_fundbrad_ev">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Escola Virtual">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_ee6ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c553</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>felipe.valenca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
